title: COURVIX — Less Administration. More Game.
status: Production preparation; final screen composites await actual app captures

shots.headline: The work behind every game.
shots.narration: Behind every great game, there's work no one sees. Teams to coordinate. Sessions to plan. Payments to follow up.
shots.visual: Authentic coach preparing training, athlete close-up, training calendar. Three controlled cuts. Separate task fragments accumulate outside the product; do not invent application UI.
shots.camera: Sport detail macro; slow dolly into training calendar.
shots.sound: Atmospheric stadium air, sparse harmonic piano, low pulse. Tension without aggressive impacts.

shots.headline: When everything feels scattered.
shots.narration: When that work lives in scattered messages and spreadsheets, the next session becomes harder than it should be.
shots.visual: Academy administrator and team manager dealing with loose task fragments. Calendar grid aligns with the real digital schedule in the next scene. No fabricated customer testimonial.
shots.camera: Controlled push-in; tighter framing creates tension.
shots.sound: Soft overlapping UI notifications dissolve to a short breath of silence.

shots.headline: Sports Management, Reimagined.
shots.narration: Meet Courvix. Sports management, reimagined. One clear home for the work behind your sport.
shots.visual: Scattered task fragments converge into the actual Club control room on an unbranded graphite laptop. Courvix orange establishes clarity.
shots.camera: Laptop reveal with a gentle 12-degree orbital move and subtle dolly-in.
shots.sound: Warm synth rise, a soft bass impact and a restrained logo accent.

shots.headline: Everything in One Place.
shots.narration: Bring member profiles, teams, schedules and attendance together. So every coach knows who's training, where, and when.
shots.visual: Actual member overview, schedule and attendance captures. Each detail appears in sequence; enlarge one readable region at a time. Physical calendar match-cut becomes the digital schedule.
shots.camera: Screen macro; pull back from member context to laptop.
shots.sound: Light synchronized confirmations, controlled electronic percussion enters.

shots.headline: Organize with Confidence.
shots.narration: Keep payment records visible, review submissions, and follow up on unpaid dues. Less chasing. A clearer next action.
shots.visual: Actual invoice/payment review and reminder controls. Visibly retain manual receipt verification; never imply automatic bank settlement or active unconfigured delivery.
shots.camera: Laptop screen dolly-in; a precise highlight follows the actual review row.
shots.sound: Subtle interface click and low data pulse; narration remains dominant.

shots.headline: Built for the Way You Coach.
shots.narration: For personal trainers, connect client goals, appointments and session packs. From verified payment to reserved credits and completed training.
shots.visual: Authentic trainer guiding a client leads into real Training control room, session pack and appointment records. Show the existing 1/4/8/16 offer concept and actual credit transitions.
shots.camera: Sports motion match-cut to credit motion; tablet at a physically plausible angle.
shots.sound: Selective sport impact, warm bass rhythm, UI reservation/completion accents.

shots.headline: Understand Your Operations.
shots.narration: See the full member story in one view. Oversee branches, then move into the workspace that needs your attention.
shots.visual: Actual combined member/client overview and real Network overview. Use only operational counts present in the app. No invented performance uplift, predictive analytics or customer statistics.
shots.camera: Expand out from an actual local workspace to the existing network view.
shots.sound: Music opens into an uplifting progression; subtle data visualization pulses.

shots.headline: Stay Connected.
shots.narration: A connected experience for the people behind the session. Clear roles, shared context, and more room to focus on coaching.
shots.visual: Laptop, tablet and smartphone use real captures at their respective viewports. Move from desk to coaching environment. Responsive website access only; do not imply native apps or offline access.
shots.camera: Motivated laptop-to-tablet-to-phone transition; separate physical devices remain believable.
shots.sound: Elegant swipe, wider stereo image and a controlled musical rise.

shots.headline: Less Administration. More Game.
shots.narration: Built for the way sports move. Courvix. Less administration. More game. Discover Courvix.
shots.visual: Unified laptop/tablet/phone hero composition. Actual Courvix logo in orange with a subtle moving highlight. CTA: Discover COURVIX. End in a clean charcoal frame.
shots.camera: Slow hero dolly-in and restrained orbit; no excessive neon or holograms.
shots.sound: Emotional synth lift and distinctive three-note original sonic mark; clean final decay.
